description: Golden vectors for AppRequest (pkt_t=0x04, ver=0x01), the object request on an app_traffic TCP connection. 24 bytes on wire. See contracts/packets/app_request.md. Layout: pkt_t(1) + ver(1) + kind(1) + activity(1) + flow_id(4) + object_id(8) + size(8).

cases.name: web_page_download
cases.notes: kind 0 = download: the server answers with size bytes. activity 1 = web_page. object_id = agent 1, episode 1, object 0.

cases.name: photo_upload
cases.notes: kind 1 = upload: size bytes follow; the server echoes these 24 bytes back once it has them all. activity 8 = photo_upload.
